title: down is
why: A mismatched engine dropped from isDown (issue 595): the Library would promise a wait for an engine that ended at the handshake and never restarts.

title: settled is
why: A ready engine not settled (issue 595): the first-run check of the bundled tools would never run on a start that succeeds.

title: settled is
why: isSettled deciding its own down states (the list it replaced, written a second time): a state counted down in one place and not settled in the other.

title: does not report the app’s own quit as a failure
why: The app's own quit reported as a failure on the Library as the engine goes down with the window.

title: carries the whole reason, first
why: The samples region dropping an unavailable engine's reason: the status line cuts a long one short, so a person would read it nowhere in full (issue 547).

title: the samples region’s sentence, state by state
why: The region deciding for itself which states are down, as it did before issue 595: a stopped or mismatched engine would be promised a wait.
